# Contributing to ICOR for Life

This repository does not take pull requests. Bugs and ideas go to the ICOR for Life community at https://myicor.com.

## License

Since 2.2.0 (myPKA 7.0.0) this folder is MIT, as `LICENSE.md` says; the INKLINE theme keeps CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 and the libraries some plugins bundle keep their own licences. You may use, change and share it on those terms.

## Security problems

Never report a security problem in a public issue or post. Report it privately as `SECURITY.md` describes. What we do with the personal data in a report: https://myicor.com/privacy#github.

## Names

Using or adapting ICOR for Life does not give you the right to use our names or logos. See the trademark notes in `LICENSE.md`.

This page states our own terms. Where it differs from `LICENSE.md`, `LICENSE.md` wins.
